original_test_intent: Disable and enable SOL for one approved isolated BMC channel through both specified access paths, prove activation is rejected then accepted, and restore the exact original SOL configuration without leaving a live session.
original_method: Use Transport 0x0C/0x21 selector 0x01 with values 0x00 and 0x01 in-band and OOB, attempting SOL after each state; source references an internal Script.
manual_activity: Security/FAE owner approves channel/account/host, selector semantics, change window, reject/accept oracle, recovery and required final baseline.
safety_requirements: Do not assume source selector values apply without schema validation
Do not send arbitrary console input
Restore complete baseline after ambiguous response
agent_execution_scope: Write disabled through required paths and read back
Assert bounded activation acceptance then deactivate
Restore complete original baseline and verify no session remains
engineer_actions: Approve console configuration change and behavior matrix
Resolve opposite/ambiguous behavior or live session

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek recognizes the risk but incorrectly implies exact parameters are absent; the source specifies examples that still need per-firmware validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, use a protected transactional 0x0C/0x21 runner with full 0x22 baseline/readback, bounded SOL reject/accept checks, unconditional deactivation and exact restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original raw commands, selector/value examples, in-band/OOB paths, reject/accept Criteria, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a recovery-backed baseline-disable-readback-reject-enable-readback-accept-cleanup-restore transaction with full parameter audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-firmware schema validation, complete baseline, bounded console handling and exact restoration without dropping any source checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: sol info/readback alone does not prove disabled rejection or enabled acceptance; a successful SOL connection without cleanup and baseline restoration is incomplete.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong selector/channel can disrupt or expose a console, and a lost response can leave state changed while the control session appears failed.

project_override_considerations: A vendor SOL policy API is equivalent only if engineer-approved and it changes the same enable field through the required paths or records the gap, proves reject/accept behavior, restores all parameters and cleans up sessions; raw 0x21 coverage remains explicit if skipped.
expected_evidence: Disable writes/readback through required paths and bounded rejection result
Enable writes/readback and bounded acceptance result
Exact complete baseline restore/re-read and recovery validation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The disable/enable Procedure and reject/accept Criteria align. Example selector/value applicability is a Project validation need, not an internal contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SOL configuration purpose and source commands are explicit. Per-firmware schema, target fixture, recovery and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Preserves full functional setter coverage while preventing read-only substitution, production console impact, incomplete sol-info verification and orphaned sessions/configuration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Configuration readback and effective access are separate oracles: the BMC may report disabled yet still allow an existing or mis-scoped session, or report enabled while payload permissions prevent activation. The test must pair each readback with a fresh bounded activation attempt, distinguish expected policy denial from transport/authentication failure, terminate any accepted session and restore every captured parameter.
